messages:
ana: quick Q — for dedicated-pool admission, do we want a compact AdmitToken handshake or a full AdmitIntent payload? trying to minimize cross-process surface. :thinking_face:

dmitri: compact AdmitToken. operator should be thin and only own resource mechanics; control-plane retains policy + billing.

sam_k: compact works but include request_id + tenant_id in the request so operator can emit logs/metrics with those tags. tracing is critical.

lee: agreement but operator needs hints for local eviction decisions: priority enum (latency|best_effort|burst) + preemptible boolean. otherwise eviction behavior diverges.

maria: suggested response fields: admit_token, estimated_warmup_ms, node_hint (optional), priority (enum), soft_reservation_id (optional). soft_reservation is advisory only.

chris: HTTP sketch:
POST /v1/operator/admit
Body: {"request_id":"r-abc","tenant_id":"team-x","slots":2,"ttl_seconds":600}
200: {"admit_token":"tok-1","estimated_warmup_ms":800,"node_hint":"rack-4","priority":"latency"}
429: {"reason":"capacity","retry_after_seconds":30}

ana: failure modes: if operator returns admit_token then OOMs during warmup, operator must emit admission_failure event (request_id+admit_token). control-plane should retry or fallback to hosted model variant.

lee: eviction flow: operator should attempt graceful drain within an eviction_safe_window (~10s) before force kill. expose /v1/operator/eviction webhook for audit and optional drain hook.

sam_k: telemetry contract: require metrics tagged with request_id, tenant_id, admit_token, warmup_duration_ms, eviction_reason. we'll use these for billing + regressions.

maria: need Revoke API from control-plane: Revoke(admit_token, reason_code, grace_seconds). operator should try to flush KV caches and return drained_seconds.

chris: proto sketch: {admit_token, request_id, revoke_reason(enum), grace_seconds} -> {revoke_ack, drained_seconds}. keep tiny.

infra-bot: note: operator-proxy v2.3 chart exposes /admit but lacks Revoke handler; ticket INF-1982 logged.

ana: actions: 1) finalize Admit/Response JSON + priority enum, 2) publish telemetry labels, 3) implement Revoke proto in operator, 4) add chaos test where operator returns admit then OOMs to validate fallback. i'll draft a short RFC with seq diagram.

dmitri: please include seq diagram showing race: control-plane -> operator/admit -> admit_token -> control-plane start warmup -> operator emits admission_failure -> control-plane fallback. clarifies edge cases.

sam_k: i'll draft the diagram + metrics table. tagging @maria for revoke reasons. :thumbsup:

maria: happy to. target RFC draft by EOD tomorrow?

ana: EOD works. thanks all.
